in_arabic.name: تمهير
in_arabic.long_meaning: تمهير هو اسم عربي يعني الهداية والرشاد إلى الخير، ومنه تمهير القرآن لأنه يهدي إلى الصراط المستقيم، وهو من الأسماء المأخوذة من مصدر تمهير الذي يعني إرشاد وتهدي الناس إلى ما ينجحهم

in_urdu.name: تمہیر
in_urdu.meaning: ہدایت اور رہبری کی طرف لے جانا
in_urdu.long_meaning: تمہیر ایک عربی نام ہے جو ہدایت اور رہبری کی طرف لے جانے کے معنی میں آتا ہے، اور یہ نام قرآن سے لیا گیا ہے جو لوگوں کو صراط مستقیم کی طرف لے جاتا ہے

in_hindi.name: तम्हीर
in_hindi.meaning: मार्गदर्शन और सही रास्ते की ओर ले जाना
in_hindi.long_meaning: तम्हीर एक अरबी नाम है जिसका अर्थ मार्गदर्शन और सही रास्ते की ओर ले जाना है, और यह नाम कुरान से लिया गया है जो लोगों को सही रास्ते पर ले जाता है

in_pashto.name: تمہیر
in_pashto.meaning: لارښود او ښې لارې ته راهيستل
in_pashto.long_meaning: تمہیر د عربي نوم دی چې د لارښود او ښې لارې ته راهيستلو په معنی کی آيی، او دا نوم قرآن څخه اخيستل شوی دی چې خلک د صراط مستقیم لورې ته راولي

data.cultural_impact: The name "Tamheer" carries a rich cultural significance rooted in the Islamic tradition. It is a powerful reminder of the fundamental Islamic principle of maintaining and uplifting the Muslim society through knowledge, creativity, and innovation. The name "Tamheer" embodies the notion of personal and communal progress. It separates those who are merely observers of life from those who actively participate in shaping the future. The word "Tamheer" instills a sense of responsibility to utilize one's potential for the betterment of self and the collective. Historically, Muslims have made significant contributions to humanity in science, mathematics, literature, art, and architecture. The name "Tamheer" continues to inspire individuals to become agents of change, contributing to the ongoing development and growth of their communities and the world at large.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name "Tamheer" lies in its underlying reminder of an essential aspect of Islamic faith - the continuous seeking of knowledge and betterment. The name is derived from the Arabic verb "chtamhara" which means "to make something grow," reflecting the never-ending pursuit of spiritual and material growth. Muslims believe that Allah SWT has bestowed them with the potential for growth and development. Thus, the name "Tamheer" encourages individuals to strive towards spiritual and moral excellence. In the personal quest for self-improvement, an individual can relate to the name and find inspiration to progress spiritually. Moreover, when used collectively, the name reminds us of the importance of contributing to the development and enrichment of the Muslim community. Ultimately, the name "Tamheer" exemplifies the harmony between spiritual and material progress and serves as a constant reminder to walk the path of growth, both internally and externally.
